MINUTES  FOR  THE  REGULAR  MEETING  OF THE
  HOUSING  AUTHORITY  OF THE  CITY  OF SOUTH  GATE

  TUESDAY,  DECEMBER  10, 2024

CALL  TO ORDER  The meeting  of the South  Gate Housing  Authority  was called  to order by
  Chairperson  Gil Hurtado  at 9:24  p.m.

ROLL  CALL  Yodit  Glaze,  City  Clerk

PRESENT  Chairperson  Gil Hurtado,  Vice  Chairperson  Maria  Davila,  Authority
  Member  Joshua Barron,  and Authority  Member  Al Rios;  City Treasurer
  Jose De La Paz, Executive  Director  Rob Houston,  Authority  Counsel  Raul
  F. Sglinas

EXCUSED/ABSENT  Authority  Member  Maria  del Pilar Avalos

DEVIATE  FROM

THE  AGENDA  At this time, there being  no objections,  Chairperson  Hurtado  stated that
  item 3 would  be considered  out of its regular  agenda  order.

3

RE-ORGANIZATION  The South  Gate Housing  Authority  appointed  a Chairperson  and Vice
  Chairperson  and ratified  the re-organization.

  Chairperson  Hurtado  nominated  Vice  Chairperson  Davila  as Chairperson
  and Authority  Member  Barron  as Vice Chairperson  and seconded  by Vice
  Chairperson  Davila.

  ROLL  CALL:  Authority  Member  Barron,  yes; Authority  Member  Rios,
  yes; Vice Chairperson  Davila,  yes; Chairperson  Hurtado,  yes; Authority
  Member  Avalos,  absent.

l
ANNUAL  REPORT

HOUSING  ASSET  FUND  The South  Gate Housing  Authority  adopted  Resolution  No. 2024-02-HA
  entitled  Resolution  of the South  Gate Housing  Authority  of the City  of
  South  Gate, California,  approving  the South  Gate Housing  Successor
  Agency  Annual  Report  regarding  the Housing  Asset  Fund activities  by
  motion  ofAuthority  Member  Hurtado  and seconded  byAuthority  Member
  Rios.

  ROLL  CALL:  Authority  Member  Rios, yes; Authority  Member  Hurtado,
  yes; Vice  Chairperson  Barron,  yes; Chairperson  Davila,  yes; Authority
  Member  Avalos,  absent.
   The South  Gate Housing  Authority  approved  the Regular  Meeting  minutes

  of November  26, 2024,  by motion  Vice  Chairperson  Barron  and seconded

  by Authority  Member  Hurtado.

  yes; Vice  Chairperson  Barron,  yes; Chairperson  Davila,  yes; Authority
  Member  Avalos,  absent.
